decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 175/178 - A01, 175/178 - A04, 175/178 - A06, 175/178 - A08, 175/178 - A11, 175/178 - A16, 175/178 - A17, 175/178 - A18 received 20/10/2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extensions hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of two single storey rear extensions and increasing roof height of the existing rear extensions for 69 and 71 Stile Hall Gardens
